admission.snapshotAt: before source copy, compilation or engine/player start
admission.linuxEngineTasks: 128 * (1 + JavaScript participant count); not measured on Linux
admission.memory: sum engine and C# member hard caps within actual reserved game scope
admission.launches: one per participant; no automatic restart

calls.timeout: stay action in this turn; same instance after actual settlement
calls.invalid-result: stay action in this turn; same instance
calls.exception: terminal user-code fault, including fatal exception settled after deadline
calls.operation-limit: terminal user-code fault, including allocation limit settled after deadline
calls.gcFailure: terminal infrastructure failure; never a timeout or player penalty
calls.scheduling: completion immediately starts action; action completion starts next calculation; no common barrier

recording.failureEvent: runtime-failure with infrastructureFailure; no user status
recording.transportFailureRecovery: query lifecycle owner only on failed direct transport; no extra IPC for successful turns

remaining: NoGC reservation exhaustion during repeated calls
